contract: sign_edges(graph, budget) -> +/-1 edge signs. graph contains n and ordered undirected edges. Construct connected 3-regular two-lifts of prism graphs; minimize mean spectral radius of signed adjacency (the new eigenvalues), checked independently. budget=32 is the baseline trial budget; all candidates share the 60-second execution ceiling. Numerical spectral ranking does not certify a general theorem.
